entry.title: Is 16 GB RAM Enough? | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Yes. Both the official minimum and recommended PC specifications list 16 GB RAM. Verified 2026-07-25 with official-source context and clearly marked evidence limits.

entry.title: Dawnwalker 21st-Century Teaser Explained | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: The Summer Game Fest CGI teaser shows Coen in a modern, 21st-century setting as a glimpse of where the overarching saga may ultimately lead. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: How Much Storage Does Dawnwalker Need? | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: The official PC requirements list 60 GB of available storage. Verified 2026-07-25 with official-source context and clearly marked evidence limits.

entry.title: Ambrus's Human Origins | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Ambrus is the youngest vampire in the clique and came from a painful, humble human life marked by humiliation. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Anca Latin Lesson Choice | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: The preview confirms that Coen can remain with Anca for an impromptu, flirtatious Latin lesson, spending more of the limited opening day. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Anca Medicine Quest Preview | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Coen's father sends him to Anca, Laslea's herbalist, to obtain stronger medicine for his traumatized mother before the Blood Mass. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Anca Character Guide | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Anca is Coen’s longtime guide and teacher, associated with reading, Latin, herbalism, and an undisclosed secret. Verified 2026-07-25 with official-source context and clearly marked evidence limits.

entry.title: Ancient Civilization Ruins | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Forgotten ruins and remnants of an ancient civilization are explorable parts of Vale Sangora. Verified 2026-07-25 with official-source context and clearly marked evidence limits.

entry.title: Do Characters Act Without Coen? | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Yes. Official descriptions say characters have their own agency and events continue with or without Coen's intervention. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Bakir's Central Asian Origins | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Before becoming a vampire, Bakir spent decades riding across the dry steppes of Central Asia while burning, trampling, and pillaging. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Bakir Motion Capture Explained | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Former UFC champion Jan Błachowicz contributed motion-capture performances for Bakir. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: The Black Death in Vale Sangora | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: The Black Death devastates Vale Sangora and is central to the vrakhiri rise. Verified 2026-07-25 with official-source context and clearly marked evidence limits.

entry.title: What Happens If You Kill a Blacksmith? | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: The official world overview gives a concrete consequence: kill a local blacksmith for gold and that forge becomes inaccessible. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Does Blocking Cost Stamina? | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Yes. The hands-on preview states that holding the block button defends against weapon attacks but consumes stamina. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Blood Convoys in Vale Sangora | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Vrakhiri store and transport human blood as a strategic resource, and Coen can encounter and disrupt blood convoys in the open world. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Blood Magic for Investigations | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Anca teaches human Coen blood magic; the preview uses it to interrogate a dead soldier for clues about the captured family. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Blood Mass Prologue Explained | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: The Blood Mass is the fixed event at the end of Laslea's opening day: adult villagers must give blood to Brencis and his clique, and Coen cannot prevent the event merely by choosing a perfect daytime route. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Why Does Coen Have 30 Days? | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Coen’s family is being held for a blood sacrament scheduled in 30 days. Verified 2026-07-25 with official-source context and clearly marked evidence limits.

entry.title: What Is the Blood Tax? | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: The blood tax is the price Brencis demands from human communities in exchange for vampiric protection. Verified 2026-07-25 with official-source context and clearly marked evidence limits.

entry.title: Brencis's Roman Name and Origin | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Brencis was born in the Roman Empire in AD 131 under the name Caeso Burrienus Laurentius. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Brencis as a Roman Senator | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Before becoming a vampire, Brencis joined the Roman Senate and rose through official life with the ambition of becoming consul. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: Brencis Shrines, Coins, and Frescoes | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: Brencis's image and coat of arms appear throughout Vale Sangora on roadside shrines, coins, and newly painted church frescoes. Verified from official or first-party material on 2026-07-25.

entry.title: What Is a Dawnwalker? | Blood of Dawnwalker Guide
entry.summary: A Dawnwalker is Coen’s incomplete vampire condition: human by day and vampire by night, with daylight causing him no harm. Verified 2026-07-25 with official-source context and clearly marked evidence limits.
